ITEM 1 | Shredded light-brown and tan meat pieces with pale edges, irregular stringy texture, moist with a reddish-orange glossy coating and small flecks of red and green, piled in a mound about 9 cm across and 3 cm high in the upper-left of the plate, sitting partly over the greens | 150
ITEM 2 | Fresh dark green leafy greens with thin stems, ruffled edges, matte and slightly moist, spread across the lower-right half of the plate covering roughly 35% of the plate surface, about 2 cm deep in the thickest part | 70
ITEM 3 | Bright yellow cubes of fruit with slightly translucent edges and a firm, moist surface, about 2 cm per side, two or three pieces grouped at the lower-left edge of the greens | 45
ITEM 4 | Pale tan and orange-brown chunks with slightly browned, uneven edges and a soft, moist interior, about 2 cm in size, scattered among the greens near the center | 30
ITEM 5 | Small thin shreds of purple-red and pale onion-like pieces, moist and translucent, scattered within the meat mound and at its base | 8
ITEM 6 | Small dark reddish-brown drizzle or sauce smear, glossy and thin, visible at the bottom edge of the greens and a few spots on the plate surface | 6
